image_description: A close-up portrait of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) with characteristic chestnut and white markings. The dog has long, silky ears with heavy feathering, large dark eyes, and a domed head. It is wearing a purple braided leash or collar. The background is a soft-focus green, suggesting an outdoor setting.
